title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha brings up Nila's insult at the restaurant, triggering a family dispute. Chozhan slaps Cheran, who leaves home, while blaming Chandayatha for the unrest.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: The four women return from the movie, pretending they visited a temple. Lakshmi drops Revathi home and lies to Thangaraj and her mother about their delay.

title: Bigg Boss
description: Muniyammal vs Vasan fight escalates. In the build-up week challenge, housemates have to trigger and remove the one seated on the King's chair, which ends in chaos.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Guilt-stricken Sethupathi breaks down, falling to his knees before Tamizhselvi in the pouring rain. Rajangam's family regrets failing to trust her despite all she's done for them.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Delighted by Karikalan's affection on her birthday, Saranya discovers Aadhavan's love for Pooja in his diary. Then she angrily confronts them for concealing their relationship.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani learns about Vennila's support for Vigneshwaran's family after enquiring with his wife. Later, she enjoys a night walk with Anbu while relishing ice cream.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan reconciles with Indhira after his words about a mother's care hurt her. Later, the family plans the reception menu as Abhi's dress price shocks Kandhasamy.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Muthuvel apologises to Vadivu for failing to give her the care she deserves. Elsewhere, Sakthivel irritates Maari by insisting that she tell others he keeps her happy.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj is stunned when Santhosh informs him of the theft at his showroom. Meanwhile, Ragu traps Muthu by introducing a bus dealer to trick him into buying a damaged bus.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Following Vethanayagam's allegations, Vetri strives to convince Abinaya of his innocence in Sandhya's issue. As the CCTV footage goes viral, Sandhya seeks revenge on Vetri.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai decides to arrange Senthamizh's marriage despite her emotional pleas. Poongodi urges him to reconsider and give her more time to complete her studies.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi suspects Kalamma bribed the lab assistant to alter the DNA results. As the family leaves for the adoption ceremony, she and Nalini head to the lab to investigate.
